newsitem.title: USA: WD-40 names Garry Ridge president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: WD-40 names Garry Ridge president, CEO.

text.p: WD-40 Co said Tuesday that Garry Ridge was named president and chief executive officer, succeeding Gerald Schleif, who will resign at the end of September.
Ridge has worked for WD-40 for 10 years in various management positions and last December became an officer of the company.
The company also announced a two-for-one stock split payable July 31 to shareholders of record July 11. And it said it will increase its post-split dividend to $0.32 per share from $0.31.
WD-40 makes a variety of lubricants for industrial, automotive and other uses.
